note:
R18 — Arena presentation packs (PS4 15–21): the stadium texture-pack / kit classes keyed by `ArenaID` (dasher boards, centre ads,
crowd chairs, scarves, stanchions, netting, spotlight logos, goal lights, jumbotron, entrance props, dressing kits, …) — per title:
each class's records, the `ArenaID` (or `Team`) value set, coverage of the DB `exhibitionarena.arenaartid` values and of the `ge_level.ID`
values, the referenced texture paths on examples. The `ge_level` records' typed slots for these packs are null in `gccollections`
(measured), so the pack's own `ArenaID` attribute is the binding candidate. Read-only. Usage: python r18_arena_packs.py <out.json>
